content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Gradient-boosted survival models have been fitted to SCADA telemetry and condition monitoring signals to generate ranked maintenance schedules, which were evaluated in retrospective simulation showing an estimated 22% reduction in unscheduled downtime hours.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02957","field":"abstract","quote":"fits gradient-boosted survival models—specifically, a discrete-time hazard model and a random survival forest—to a combined dataset of SCADA telemetry and tower-mounted accelerometer readings"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Statistical feature extraction from SCADA records combined with machine learning classification has demonstrated ability to identify incipient faults 48 hours before failure across multiple sites with acceptable cross-site generalisation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08182","field":"abstract","quote":"a detection window of 48 hours before the logged fault event was used"}]}]}
